_provenance: Every number in this file was either pasted directly from an executed Colab notebook's printed output, or computed live with scipy/numpy and shown to the author before being included. See README 'What is and isn't in this repo' for what is NOT included: full per-step history.json / embed_log.npz files for every run, which live on the author's Google Drive and are not duplicated here.

single_seed_conditions_incomplete.note: hard_easy, residue_blocks, balanced_mini_epoch, and most multiplication runs were single seed-0 attempts, several of which did not complete their full 20000-step budget due to free-tier Colab GPU quota limits. Not included here as they are not reliable enough to report as findings; see paper Section 3.2.

weight_norm.note: Decreases sharply from initialization (~118-119) to ~27-37 by end of training across all 15 runs, consistent with Nanda et al. (2023) Fig. 1 bottom-right. Not strictly monotonic (small fluctuations, likely AdamW noise) but never exhibits a rise-then-fall and carries no leading signal.

gini_progress_measure.note: Gini coefficient of the Fourier-transformed embedding norms reaches half its total rise 250 steps before the 95% validation threshold is crossed, in both conditions computed.

multiplication.note: RUN_MUL flag in the Study 2 grid script defaults to False. Not run for this paper; noted as a limitation.
